name: Dana
label: Shared family plan parent
who: I pay for a family plan that covers several people in my household, and each person keeps their own account. I care about keeping everyone's playlists separate and making the cost per person as low as possible.
value_for_money: Positive. Describes the family or duo plan as cheap per person, with one saying a shared plan works out to a few dollars a month each and is worth it to remove ads.
loyalty: Keeps the plan because it gives everyone in the household their own account and an ad-free listening experience. Says they would never go back to the free version.
pain_points: Being forced onto a duo or family plan when only one person needs it
Confusion about switching from an individual plan to a family plan
Worry about losing playlists when joining a family plan
Address verification requirements for family members
tone: Practical and matter-of-fact, focused on logistics and cost per person.
